evidence.note: Timely company documentation describes capture and memory functions but independently establishes neither comprehensive coverage nor persuasive capability.
Earlier firsthand reporting describes wearable capture and recall limitations. It neither demonstrates the forecast's full capability nor establishes a durable barrier.

reviews.rationale: The packet establishes neither a joint demonstration of comprehensive wearable speech access and broad persuasive capability nor a durable barrier to either. Current capture limitations and uncertain personalization benefits do not disprove the forecast. No deadline or qualifying conclusive event permits resolution.
